dialogues.jp:
真っ直ぐ家に帰るのもなんなので、学園から公
園に足を向けてみる。
dialogues.en: Instead of going straight home, I walk to the park.
dialogues.text: Instead of going straight home, I walk to the park.

dialogues.jp:
ことりがいるかな、と桜の林に入ったりもした
けれど、今日は用事があったみたいだ。
dialogues.en:
I look for Kotori among the cherry blossom trees, but she
isn't there. She must be busy today.
dialogues.text:
I look for Kotori among the cherry blossom trees, but she
isn't there. She must be busy today.

dialogues.jp: 「……さて、どうしよっかな」
dialogues.en: "Well, what am I gonna do now?"
dialogues.text: "Well, what am I gonna do now?"

dialogues.jp:
ただの散歩になったとしても、そう悪くない陽
気と雰囲気なのだが、家に遠回りになったぶん
の手間をどうにかしたい。
dialogues.en:
It's turned out to be a boring walk, but the weather's
lovely, so I want to make this detour meaningful.
dialogues.text:
It's turned out to be a boring walk, but the weather's
lovely, so I want to make this detour meaningful.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢にお土産でも買ってってやるか」
dialogues.en: "I'll buy Nemu a souvenir."
dialogues.text: "I'll buy Nemu a souvenir."

dialogues.jp:
公園の中にいつも開いている屋台を遠くに見て、
財布の中身を確認する。
dialogues.en:
I check inside my wallet, looking at the vendor the other
side of the park.
dialogues.text:
I check inside my wallet, looking at the vendor the other
side of the park.

dialogues.jp: う〜ん、小銭で重い……。
dialogues.en: Hmm... It's heavy with lots of coins.
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's heavy with lots of coins.

dialogues.jp:
美味しいチョコバナナの屋台があるとか聞いた
のだが、いくらかなぁ。
dialogues.en:
I heard there's a vendor who sells chocolate-coated bananas,
but I wonder how much they are.
dialogues.text:
I heard there's a vendor who sells chocolate-coated bananas,
but I wonder how much they are.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「海〜、海はいいよぉ、日本海がいいよぉ♪」
dialogues.en: "The sea... I love the sea, especially Japanese seas."
dialogues.text: "The sea... I love the sea, especially Japanese seas."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
存在が不穏当な発言を耳にして振り返ると、ひょ
こひょこ、と金髪とその頭の上の猫が揺れてい
た。
dialogues.en:
Hearing a strange remark, I turn around. Then I see blonde
hair, with a cat wobbling around on top of it.
dialogues.text:
Hearing a strange remark, I turn around. Then I see blonde
hair, with a cat wobbling around on top of it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃん発見」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I found you, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I found you, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらが足と手を伸ばしたまま、コマみたいに
振り向いたので、頭の上の猫がふらふらと揺れ
る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura straightens her arms and legs and spins around like a
top, making the cat on her head wobble.
dialogues.text:
Sakura straightens her arms and legs and spins around like a
top, making the cat on her head wobble.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「珍しいところで会うね……運命？」
dialogues.en: "What a coincidence to see you here! Could it be destiny?"
dialogues.text: "What a coincidence to see you here! Could it be destiny?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ベートーベンなんてどうでもいいけど、確か
　に珍しいところで会うな」
dialogues.en:
"I don't care about Beethoven's piano works, but it's a real
surprise to see you here."
dialogues.text:
"I don't care about Beethoven's piano works, but it's a real
surprise to see you here."

dialogues.jp: 猫のバランスを支えてやりながら頷く。
dialogues.en: She nods, holding the cat so that it doesn't fall off.
dialogues.text: She nods, holding the cat so that it doesn't fall off.

dialogues.jp:
日曜とかだと誰に会っても不思議ではないが、
学園の帰りとなると珍しい。
dialogues.en:
It's possible to run into somebody you know on Sunday, but
it doesn't happen so often after school.
dialogues.text:
It's possible to run into somebody you know on Sunday, but
it doesn't happen so often after school.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、島の東側に住んでるヤツは、ここにいれ
ば結構見かけるものだが。
dialogues.en:
Well, you see them often if you live in the east side of the
island.
dialogues.text:
Well, you see them often if you live in the east side of the
island.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃん暇？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, do you have some time now?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, do you have some time now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「暇だぞ……生きてるだけで精一杯って感じだ
　けどな」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I do. Actually, I'm busy just being alive."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I do. Actually, I'm busy just being alive."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あのねあのね、友達に見晴らしのいいところ
　があるって聞いたんだけど一緒に行く？」
dialogues.en:
"Listen, a friend of mine told me there's a scenic lookout
around here. Do you want to go there with me?"
dialogues.text:
"Listen, a friend of mine told me there's a scenic lookout
around here. Do you want to go there with me?"

dialogues.jp:
頭のてっぺんから大きく横に手を広げて、すご
いんだよぉ、とさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en:
Sakura smiles, spreading her arms wide as she tells me how
beautiful it is.
dialogues.text:
Sakura smiles, spreading her arms wide as she tells me how
beautiful it is.

dialogues.jp: 「海か？」
dialogues.en: "By the sea?"
dialogues.text: "By the sea?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ。よく知ってるね」
dialogues.en: "Yes. How did you know?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. How did you know?"

dialogues.jp: そりゃ、あんだけ歌ってればな……。
dialogues.en: Anyone could guess if you sing about it so many times...
dialogues.text: Anyone could guess if you sing about it so many times...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、行こーよ！」
dialogues.en: "Let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「別にいいけど」
dialogues.en: "I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "I don't mind."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはは。ダメだよ、そんな｛あいまい／曖昧｝なこと言っ
　てると人生楽しめないよ。ラッキー・ゴー・
　ハッピーだよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. C'mon, you can't be so ambiguous, otherwise you
won't have much fun in your life. Be happy-go-lucky!"
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. C'mon, you can't be so ambiguous, otherwise you
won't have much fun in your life. Be happy-go-lucky!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「笑うカドには福来る」
dialogues.en: "They say fortune comes in at the merry gate."
dialogues.text: "They say fortune comes in at the merry gate."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前が近くにいれば十分だろ」
dialogues.en: "You would bring me enough luck, I guess."
dialogues.text: "You would bring me enough luck, I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: 見上げてくるさくらに小さく笑いかける。
dialogues.en: I give a little smile at Sakura, who is glancing up at me.
dialogues.text: I give a little smile at Sakura, who is glancing up at me.

dialogues.jp: 「いつも俺の側に来ちゃ笑ってるんだから」
dialogues.en: "Every time you appear, you make me smile."
dialogues.text: "Every time you appear, you make me smile."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへ♪」
dialogues.en: "Teeheehee!"
dialogues.text: "Teeheehee!"

dialogues.jp:
本当に、見た目だけなら天使が寄って来そうな
幸せそうな、だらしない顔だな。
dialogues.en:
She looks so happy. She's smiling so much it could attract
angels.
dialogues.text:
She looks so happy. She's smiling so much it could attract
angels.

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、と上着の｛すそ／裾｝をつかんで、ねー、と笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura laughs, pulling my sleeve.
dialogues.text: Sakura laughs, pulling my sleeve.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、笑うカドの“カド”ってなにか
　な？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, what does that saying mean by 'the merry
gate'?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, what does that saying mean by 'the merry
gate'?"

dialogues.jp:
曲がり角のことかな？　なんて、さくらが恐ろ
しい呟きを残す。
dialogues.en: She's seriously wondering if it means a house gate.
dialogues.text: She's seriously wondering if it means a house gate.

dialogues.jp:
「……いつも朗らかなやつは、転校生と曲がり
　角でぶつかるってことじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"I think it means that happy people bash into new students
at the gate."
dialogues.text:
"I think it means that happy people bash into new students
at the gate."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……奥が深い……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... You're so intelligent."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... You're so intelligent."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前も転校生ならそれくらいしないとな」
dialogues.en: "If you're a new student, you should experience it."
dialogues.text: "If you're a new student, you should experience it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「次から気をつけるよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll try next time."
dialogues.text: "I'll try next time."

dialogues.jp:
冗談に真面目に答えるさくらから空に視線を移
して、そういえば高台に行くには階段を上る必
要があったことを思い出す。
dialogues.en:
I lift my eyes from Sakura, failing to get the joke, up to
the sky, and remember we have to use the steps to go up the
hill.
dialogues.text:
I lift my eyes from Sakura, failing to get the joke, up to
the sky, and remember we have to use the steps to go up the
hill.

dialogues.jp: あぁ――。
dialogues.en: Oh...
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "The sea!!"
dialogues.text: "The sea!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……はぁはぁ」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff."
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "THE SEA!!"
dialogues.text: "THE SEA!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……やっと着いたか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, God... this is a pain."
dialogues.text: "Oh, God... this is a pain."

dialogues.jp:
ベンチでため息をつきながら、海に向かって意
味もなく叫ぶさくらを見つめる。
dialogues.en: I finally catch my breath enough to speak.
dialogues.text: I finally catch my breath enough to speak.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「広い、大きい、青い〜！！」
dialogues.en:
Taking a breather on the bench, I watch Sakura chattering at
the ocean.
dialogues.text:
Taking a breather on the bench, I watch Sakura chattering at
the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……うるさいぞ」
dialogues.en: "So big, large and blue!"
dialogues.text: "So big, large and blue!"

dialogues.jp: 子供を叱り付ける親父ほどの元気はない。
dialogues.en: "Be quiet..."
dialogues.text: "Be quiet..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うわ、うわぁ、日本の海だよ！　飛行機から
　見てもいまいち実感なかったけど、海の匂い
　がするよ！」
dialogues.en: I don't have the energy to scold the child like a father.
dialogues.text: I don't have the energy to scold the child like a father.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en:
"Wow, wow, this is the Japanese sea! When I saw it from the
airplane, I couldn't really feel what it was like, but now I
can smell it for real!"
dialogues.text:
"Wow, wow, this is the Japanese sea! When I saw it from the
airplane, I couldn't really feel what it was like, but now I
can smell it for real!"

dialogues.jp: なにがそんなに嬉しいのか。
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: I don't know why she is so happy.
dialogues.text: I don't know why she is so happy.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "...It's the sea."
dialogues.text: "...It's the sea."

dialogues.jp: さくらが静かに海を見つめる。
そんなさくらを、俺は静かに見つめる。
dialogues.en: Sakura looks at the ocean quietly.
dialogues.text: Sakura looks at the ocean quietly.

dialogues.en: And I look at Sakura quietly.
dialogues.text: And I look at Sakura quietly.

dialogues.jp: あぁ、そうか。

しばらく頬杖をついてぼう、としていると、ふ
と思いついた。
dialogues.en: Oh, I see.
dialogues.text: Oh, I see.

dialogues.jp: さくらのやつ、ここの景色が懐かしいんだ。
dialogues.en: As I daydream with my chin in my hand, I remember something.
dialogues.text: As I daydream with my chin in my hand, I remember something.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん、この海の向こうにはなに
　があるんだろう？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan, do you know what's beyond this ocean?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan, do you know what's beyond this ocean?"

dialogues.jp:
どこか方角も分からない方向に手を向けて、さ
くらが目を輝かせる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's eyes sparkle as she points her hand towards the
unknown.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's eyes sparkle as she points her hand towards the
unknown.

dialogues.jp:
「さぁ……ずっと海があって、どこかの陸地に
　｛たど／辿｝り付くんじゃないかな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I think it goes all the way to another continent."
dialogues.text: "Well, I think it goes all the way to another continent."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そうかな？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think so?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクはまだ、どんなに科学が発達しても、み
　んなの知らないことがあると思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"I think there'll always be things that nobody can find out,
even if science marches on."
dialogues.text:
"I think there'll always be things that nobody can find out,
even if science marches on."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「船乗りにでもなって探すか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to become a sailor and find out?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to become a sailor and find out?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんと一緒なら、ボクは喜んでいく
　よ♪」
dialogues.en: "I'd love to, if you'll come with me."
dialogues.text: "I'd love to, if you'll come with me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "Really..."
dialogues.text: "Really..."

dialogues.jp: しみじみ、と口元を隠しつつ笑う。
dialogues.en: I smile, covering my mouth with my hand.
dialogues.text: I smile, covering my mouth with my hand.

dialogues.jp: さくらが手を振り上げて大きく笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura laughs loudly and raises her arms.
dialogues.text: Sakura laughs loudly and raises her arms.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはフック船長だ！」
dialogues.en: "I am Captain Hook!"
dialogues.text: "I am Captain Hook!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そりゃ海賊だよ」
dialogues.en: "He's a pirate, though."
dialogues.text: "He's a pirate, though."

dialogues.jp: ベンチにそのまま寝そべって目を閉じる。
dialogues.en: I close my eyes, lying on the bench.
dialogues.text: I close my eyes, lying on the bench.

dialogues.jp: まぶたを日が焼く。
dialogues.en: I can feel the warmth of the sunlight on my eyelids.
dialogues.text: I can feel the warmth of the sunlight on my eyelids.

dialogues.jp:
その日は、さくらの夢の航海日誌を日暮れまで
聞いていた。
dialogues.en:
I listened to the tales from Sakura's ship's log until
evening.
dialogues.text:
I listened to the tales from Sakura's ship's log until
evening.

dialogues.en: ◆Ocean...◆
dialogues.text: ◆Ocean...◆

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく公園の屋台で買い食いしようと思っ
ていたら、さくらに出会った。
dialogues.en:
I ran into Sakura at the park while I was thinking of buying
something to eat from a pushcart vendor.
dialogues.text:
I ran into Sakura at the park while I was thinking of buying
something to eat from a pushcart vendor.

dialogues.jp:
そのままふたりで高台に登ると、さくらは俺と
一緒だったら、この広い海に冒険に出てもいい
なんて言い出してしまった。
dialogues.en:
We went up a hill together, and Sakura mentioned that she'd
like to go off adventuring on the ocean, if I'd go with her.
dialogues.text:
We went up a hill together, and Sakura mentioned that she'd
like to go off adventuring on the ocean, if I'd go with her.

dialogues.jp:
その空想の冒険談に耳を澄ましながら、うらら
かな春の日の午後を満喫した。
dialogues.en:
I enjoyed the glorious spring afternoon, listening to her
stories of adventure in an imaginary world.
dialogues.text:
I enjoyed the glorious spring afternoon, listening to her
stories of adventure in an imaginary world.
